adjudication_rationale: The change moves an unbounded trust-bundle read from the updater path onto the pre-SCM boot path. A FIFO bundle hanging indefinitely was confirmed empirically; on Windows a slow or unreachable share likely exceeds the SCM start window. Reproducible failure of the agent to start on its ordinary boot path meets I5(a). E4 (admin-authored config) and E5 (rare environment) are explicitly not downgrades and E6 does not apply. Band HIGH, BLOCKING (an escalation over the reporters' MEDIUM; the stronger reading governs).
trigger: --update-trust-bundle / YUZU_UPDATE_TRUST_BUNDLE names a FIFO with no writer (blocks forever), a FIFO fed by a writer (unbounded read), or on Windows an unreachable UNC/SMB path at boot (exceeds the ~30s SCM start window -> 1053)

summary: Boot-path probe_trust_bundle (update_signature_mode.cpp:118 -> detached_signature.cpp X509_STORE_load_locations) runs synchronously in main() before the Windows SCM hand-off and before connect. classification_rationale: the reporting-only startup block is documented as never affecting enforcement or boot, yet an exception escaping it terminates the agent
summary: The #5249 startup block in main() has no try/catch (main has no top-level catch; CLI11_PARSE catches only ParseError). CLI11 2.6.2 on MSVC classifies std::filesystem::path as wstring_assignable and assigns via widen() = UTF-8 decode (TypeTools.hpp:696-731,1247-1249; Encoding_inl.hpp:96), so update_signature_mode.cpp:115 and detached_signature.cpp:111/129 path::string() can throw std::system_error -> std::terminate on every boot before the SCM hand-off (service crash loop). At origin/main the boot path only called would_fail_open() (no conversion). The cpp-safety/cpp-expert mitigation 'the path round-trips from narrow ACP input' was refuted by the adjudicator's reading of CLI11 headers and probes. Pre-existing and out of scope: a non-ASCII value that is NOT valid UTF-8 already terminates inside CLI11 parsing (std::range_error) - file separately. Raised by cross-platform (xp-1, derived HIGH) and cpp-safety (safe-2, MEDIUM, trigger unresolved) in the same Gate 3 wave; echoed by UP-15, CH-3/CH-4, co-3, sre6-1. Test: Windows CI case asserting the startup block does not throw on a non-ACP path.
